audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart called LeBlanc the winner of levels 1 through 4-5 and Skill everywhere after; content and packet say the early game is Skill, level 6 is Malzahar, first item is LeBlanc, 2+ items Malzahar.
audit.why: 57.28% winrate over 3628 games supports the content story: even early, Malzahar spikes at 6 (R cancels Distortion), LeBlanc spikes at Luden's/Malignance, Malzahar wins again with Zhonya's + full DoT.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Malzahar/LeBlanc/Malzahar with matching whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never marked LeBlanc's first-item spike as her window — the full layer's phases[5] praised Malzahar's Liandry's spike instead.
audit.why: Content spikes[2] correctly describes her Luden's/Malignance timing (W-in, E-root, burst before R lands, W out); the full layer now agrees.
audit.corrected: phases[5] rewritten to her item spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood/tradeBad were the Kassadin shield template ('poke his shield off') — LeBlanc has no shield. breakdown.cooldowns had no digits and a fabricated passive name 'Iron Boundary'. Twenty-plus fields misgendered LeBlanc.
audit.why: Kit: Distortion 15s rank 1 with a 4s return window; Ethereal Chains 14s and a projectile you can sidestep; Mimic only 45/35/25s so the double-spell is nearly always up post-6. Malzahar R suppresses her before she can take the W return; Void Shift eats the opening burst.
audit.corrected: Trades rebuilt around the spent Distortion window with real cooldowns; pronouns fixed everywhere lint flagged.

edits.before: - LeBlanc Distortion: matchup-defining — Dash with a four-second return window — punish the return spot, and remember she is broke after it. Check it before every step-up. - spell shield (Iron Boundary) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Distortion is 15s at rank 1 with a 4s return window — punish the return spot; after it she has no escape for ten-plus seconds. - Ethereal Chains is 14s: sidestep the projectile and her kill combo is gone that long. - Mimic is only 45/35/25s, so post-6 assume the double-spell is up.
